title: Ordinary normalized evaluation on a graph gives constant-sheaf coordinates
statement: Let $V$ be a connected scheme, $\ell$ a prime, $P$ a finite group, and $c:Y\to V$ a finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(P)$-torsor with connected total space [def-weil-connected-scheme], [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbb Z/\ell)$-modules on the small etale site of $V$, and let $A$ be a module such that $c^*F\simeq\underline A_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Write $M=F(Y)$ and use the section spaces and restriction maps of [def-weil-pbc-torsor-associated-module], with the torsor site object of [def-weil-pbc-torsor-section-representation]. Suppose a family of linear maps $\beta_T:F(T)\to\operatorname{LC}(T\times_VY,M)$ commutes with restrictions, and satisfies $\beta_Y(s)(y,y)=s$ for all $s\in M$ and $y\in Y$. No equivariance is assumed. For every etale $V$-object $W$ supplied with $f:W\to Y$ over $V$, the map $s\mapsto\beta_W(s)\circ(\mathrm{id}_W,f)$ from $F(W)$ to $\operatorname{LC}(W,M)$ is bijective.

proof.text: Use the etale inverse-image/localization comparison [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] to restrict F to c.P, then forget module scalars. The supplied trivialization and constantCommuteCompose identify this abelian sheaf with the constant abelian sheaf of A. The proved upstream constantSheafIsoContinuousMapSheaf identifies it with continuous functions to discrete A. Connectedness and a point of c.P identify F(c.P) additively with A. Regard W as etale over c.P using f; the comparison isomorphism and this coefficient equivalence give gamma:F(W) ≃ LC(W,F(c.P)). For each section and point w use the open fibre of its A-valued function through w. Its inclusion i:U→W and the coefficient x in F(c.P) satisfy F(i)(s)=F(i≫f)(x), by naturality of the comparison and injectivity of its component. This is the fully proved private helper constantCoordinates_localRestriction.

Given s and w choose U,i,z,x from the private constant-coordinate lemma, with i(z)=w and gamma(s)(w)=x. Prove the two pullback graph identities graph(i≫f)≫sectionRestriction(i)=i≫graph(f) and graph(i≫f)≫sectionRestriction(i≫f)=(i≫f)≫diagonal by pullback.hom_ext. Naturality of beta along i and i≫f, the equality of the restricted sections, and diagonal normalization show graphEvaluation(beta(s))(w)=x. Extensionality gives graphEvaluation(beta(s))=gamma(s) for all s. Rewrite the graph evaluation function as gamma and apply Equiv.bijective. No equivariance, torsor splitting, or nonemptiness of W is required.

theorem Scheme.GaloisCover.ordinaryGraphEvaluation_bijective
    {V : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace V] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (P : Type u) [Group P] [Finite P]
    (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} P) V) [ConnectedSpace c.P]
    (F : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
    (A : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))
    (h : Nonempty ((c.π)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj F ≅
      (constantSheaf c.P.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))).obj A))
    (β : ∀ T : V.Etaleᵒᵖ, F.obj.obj T →ₗ[ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)]
      LocallyConstant (c.sectionSpace T.unop) (F.obj.obj (Opposite.op c.sectionObject)))
    (hβ : ∀ (T T' : V.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : T ⟶ T') (s : F.obj.obj T)
        (x : c.sectionSpace T'.unop),
      β T' (F.obj.map g s) x = β T s (c.sectionRestriction g.unop x))
    (hΔ : ∀ (s : F.obj.obj (Opposite.op c.sectionObject)) (y : c.P),
      β (Opposite.op c.sectionObject) s
        (pullback.lift (f := c.π) (g := c.π) (𝟙 c.P) (𝟙 c.P) (by simp) y) = s) (W : V.Etaleᵒᵖ)
    (f : W.unop ⟶ c.sectionObject) :
    Function.Bijective (fun s : F.obj.obj W ↦
      LocallyConstant.comap
        (pullback.lift (f := W.unop.hom) (g := c.π) (𝟙 W.unop.left) f.left
          (by simpa using (MorphismProperty.Over.w f).symm)).base.hom
        (β W s))
